title: Lightbringer
order_note: Sorted by recording id: C (cinematics), M (in-engine cutscenes), T (gameplay transmissions); unit barks follow their trigger group. Interleaving of C/M/T is not confirmed.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Lord Uther! Did you face Prince Arthas?

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: No. By the time I had consecrated Terenas's remains, Arthas had left the city.
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]No. By the time I had consecrated Terenas's remains, Arthas had left the city.[/"Angry"]

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Your captain is not with you. Did he...

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: He was murdered by that traitor Rivendare. If not for Captain Landen, I'd be dead too.
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.25 easein=0.45 easeout=0.55]He was murdered by that traitor Rivendare.[/"Angry"] ["Sad" type=quad v2=0.25 v3=0.5 easein=0.55 easeout=0.45]If not for Captain Landen, I'd be dead too.[/"Sad"]

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: I grieve with you, Lieutenant. We must ensure that his sacrifice was not made in vain.
lines.raw: ["Sad" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]I grieve with you, Lieutenant. We must ensure that his sacrifice was not made in vain.[/"Sad"]

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Unfortunately, Andorhal is now surrounded by cultists and necromancers. We don’t have the strength to break their siege.

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: I will bring the survivors to Hearthglen and gather reinforcements. You remain here and harry the cultists until I return.

lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: The cult must not take Andorhal. Light guide your path.
